key_insight: A zero-cost Google-based workflow can scale assessment for a national mechanical ventilation curriculum by automating reminders, portfolio tracking, and grading.
clinical_relevance: Improving assessment logistics may help training programs handle larger learner cohorts while preserving timely feedback and educator capacity.
method: Built a standardized portfolio tracking system with automated deadlines and reminders using Google tools.
Compared portfolio completion before and after automation across two academic cycles.
Implemented an automatically graded multiple-choice case-based waveform exam with expert-defined partial-credit scoring.
evidence_signal: Fall 2025 showed higher portfolio submission (68.5% vs 45.6%) and more complete waveform uploads among submitters (55.6% vs 29.0%), while automated exam grading saved 8.5 hours per grader per cycle and matched expert scoring.
watch_item: Results come from a single program and proof-of-concept grading workflow, so broader adoption may depend on local workflow fit, rubric quality, and learner engagement.
paper_title: Zero-Cost Digital Automation for Scalable Assessment in a National Mechanical Ventilation Curriculum
